hooks.command: if exist .trellis\spec\android_tv (echo Trellis spec already exists) else (if not exist .trellis\spec mkdir .trellis\spec && if not exist .trellis\spec\android_tv mkdir .trellis\spec\android_tv && xcopy /E /Y spec\* .trellis\spec\android_tv\ >nul 2>&1 && echo Trellis spec copied to .trellis\spec\android_tv)
